lane: CAM-1 camera bounds and semantic focus
summary: Bounded all camera creation, zoom, pan, and state overrides to the 1600x900 world; made displayed LOD focus-aware; changed employer framing to 2.0x; and preserved the current employer camera when opening a project while retaining deterministic direct-project framing.

claims.claim: Every public camera mutation path used by the feature now constrains center and zoom against a 1600x900 stage.
Employer-only focus always reports city LOD and project LOD requires a selected project.
Employer default focus is now 2.0x and arbitrary state camera overrides are constrained before storage.
Opening a project from employer focus stores the current camera under the new project focus key instead of recentering.
The app data-lod and header label now use semantic focus-aware LOD.

deviations: No typecheck script exists, so the packet-directed fallback build was run.
The full test suite had one failure in a frozen scene-coordinate expectation changed concurrently outside this lane; this lane did not edit the forbidden test or scene files.
risks_blockers: The bounds deliberately assume the accepted fixed 1600x900 logical world stage; changing that stage requires updating the exported stage constants.
The shared suite must be rerun after the concurrent scene-coordinate test update lands.
ledger_updates: Suggested: record CAM-1 as implemented, build-green, with shared full-suite rerun pending the concurrent frozen-coordinate update.
